title: Sequencing and Data Quality Control
author: Adriana Alberti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qwjdxcn

steps.title: Trim and Clean Raw Reads
steps.instruction: Process raw reads using fastx_clean to remove adapters, primers, and low-quality bases.

substeps.instruction: Remove Illumina adapters and primers used during library construction from whole reads.
Remove nucleotides with quality value <20 from both ends.
Keep the longest sequence without adapters and low quality bases.
Trim sequences from the second unknown nucleotide (N) to the end of the read.
Discard reads shorter than 30 nucleotides after trimming.

steps.title: Filter Quality Control Sequences
steps.instruction: Remove reads and their mates that map onto run quality control sequences (Enterobacteria phage PhiX174 genome, GenBank NC_001422.1) using SOAP aligner.

steps.title: Filter Ribosomal Reads
steps.instruction: Remove ribosomal reads from metatranscriptomic libraries using SortMeRNA v 1.0.

substeps.instruction: Map reads and their mates against a ribosomal sequences database.
Split data into two files: rRNA reads (ribo_clean) and non-rRNA reads (noribo_clean).

steps.title: Estimate Sequence Duplication Rates
steps.instruction: Use fastx_estimate_duplicate to estimate duplicated sequence rates for single and paired sequences on both raw and cleaned reads.

steps.title: Perform Taxonomic Assignation
steps.instruction: Assign taxonomy to a randomized subset of 20,000 reads.

substeps.instruction: Align the 20,000 reads against the nt database (http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nucleotide) using Mega BLAST (Blast 2.2.15 suite).

steps.title: Merge Paired Reads
steps.instruction: Merge paired reads using fastx_mergepairs based on specific alignment criteria.

substeps.instruction: Extract the first 36 nucleotides of read2 and align this seed with read1.
Execute merging if alignment is at least 15 nucleotides, with fewer than 4 mismatches and at least 90% identity.
Retain the nucleotide of higher quality for each overlapping position.

steps.title: Calculate Read Metrics
steps.instruction: Evaluate raw and cleaned reads using pipeline-specific toolboxes to calculate quality metrics.

substeps.instruction: Calculate read size, quality values, N positions, and base composition.
